/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,json
mids=['MA1516.1','MA1516.2','MA0139.2','MA0148.4','MA0037.3','MA0058.4','MA0137.4','MA1115.1','MA0106.3','MA2339.1','MA0114.2','MA0108.3','MA0476.2','MA0147.3','MA0488.2','MA0480.1','MA0769.2','MA0143.3','MA0024.3','MA0018.5','MA0035.5']
def cons(pfm):
    # pfm keys A,C,G,T lists
    n=len(pfm['A'])
    out=''
    for i in range(n):
        vals={'A':pfm['A'][i],'C':pfm['C'][i],'G':pfm['G'][i],'T':pfm['T'][i]}
        mx=max(vals.values())
        if mx==0: out+='N'; continue
        tops=[b for b,v in vals.items() if v==mx]
        if len(tops)>1: out+='N'  # not standard but okay
        else: out+=tops[0]
    return out
for mid in mids:
 try:
  req=urllib.request.Request('https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/'+mid+'/',headers={'Accept':'application/json'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20) as r:d=json.load(r)
  pfm=d['pfm']
  print(mid,d['name'],'len',len(pfm['A']),'consensus',cons(pfm))
  print('   A',pfm['A'])
  print('   C',pfm['C'])
  print('   G',pfm['G'])
  print('   T',pfm['T'])
 except Exception as e: print(mid,'ERR',e)
PY"

events.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,json
from pathlib import Path
mids=[
('MA0148.5','FOXA1'),
('MA0037.3','GATA3'),
('MA0058.4','MAX'),
('MA0137.4','STAT1'),
('MA1115.2','POU5F1_OCT4'),
('MA0106.3','TP53_P53'),
('MA2339.1','NANOG'),
('MA0114.5','HNF4A'),
('MA0108.3','TBP'),
('MA0476.2','FOS'),
('MA0147.4','MYC'),
('MA0488.2','JUN'),
('MA0480.3','FOXO1'),
('MA0139.2','CTCF'),
('MA0769.3','TCF7'),
('MA0143.5','SOX2'),
('MA0024.3','E2F1'),
('MA0018.5','CREB1'),
('MA0035.5','GATA1'),
('MA1516.2','KLF3'),
]
motifs=[]
for mid,name in mids:
    req=urllib.request.Request('https://jaspar.elixir.no/api/v1/matrix/'+mid+'/',headers={'Accept':'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:d=json.load(r)
    pfm=d['pfm']
    w=len(pfm['A'])
    mat=[]
    for i in range(w):
        total=pfm['A'][i]+pfm['C'][i]+pfm['G'][i]+pfm['T'][i]
        row=[pfm['A'][i]/total,pfm['C'][i]/total,pfm['G'][i]/total,pfm['T'][i]/total]
        mat.append(row)
    motifs.append((mid+'_'+name,mat))
lines=['MEME version 4','','ALPHABET= ACGT','','strands: + -','','Background letter frequencies','A 0.25 C 0.25 G 0.25 T 0.25','']
for mid,wm in motifs:
    lines.append('MOTIF '+mid)
    lines.append(f'letter-probability matrix: alength= 4 w= {len(wm)} nsites= 20 E= 0')
    for row in wm:
        lines.append('  '+' '.join(f'{x:.6f}' for x in row))
    lines.append('')
out='\\n'.join(lines)
Path('/workspace/jaspar_motifs.meme').write_text(out)
print(out[:1000])
print('total chars',len(out))
PY"
